$comment: Copy to migration.config.json (gitignored) per client. ${VAR} values are read from environment / .env

source.$kind: OPTIONAL override of the PLATFORM the adapter reads from: wordpress | dandomain | fixture. Derived from the adapter when absent; only ever set to move an adapter to a different platform. It decides whether WordPress posts/pages are exported, so an unrecognised value is a hard error, not a fallback — otherwise a capital letter would silently produce an export with no content.

woocommerce.$ordersAfter: ISO date, e.g. 2023-01-01T00:00:00 — limit exported order history

source.$dandomain: Used only when adapter is `dandomain`. The SOAP endpoint is per-solution; tenant is the sfstatic/mywebshop subdomain and is what media URLs are built from (R14/R21/R32).

dandomain.$lineBasis: REQUIRED, no default: `net` if OrderLine.Price excludes VAT, `gross` if it includes it. R1/R2 — Product.Price is VAT-INCLUSIVE while order lines and Order.Total are NET, and Order.Vat / OrderLine.VatRate are ALWAYS 0, so this cannot be derived from the payload. Guessing it silently misprices every historical order, so the adapter refuses to construct without it.
dandomain.$pageBase: 0 or 1 — which page index the server's Page argument starts at. Left null it is PROBED (scripts/probe-dandomain.mjs pagebase); set it only to pin a measured answer.
dandomain.$language: Language id for a multi-language solution. Null exports the solution default.
dandomain.$storefrontUrl: R39/R41 — the STOREFRONT host. `{tenant}.webshop.dandomain.dk` is the admin SPA and answers 200 for every path, including invented ones, so it must never be used to test whether a URL exists.
dandomain.$pageFolderIds: R36 — the folder list omits folder 0, which HOLDS pages. Left null the adapter sweeps the discovered ids UNION {0}.
dandomain.$throttle: Invariant #3: rate limits are learned, not hardcoded. This is a floor to be polite from the first call, not a measured limit.
dandomain.$multiLanguage: When true (or options.importTranslations), export secondary SOAP language layers to raw/i18n-products.jsonl for transform → translations.jsonl.

shopify.$auth: Dev Dashboard app: set clientId+clientSecret (token minted automatically). Legacy custom app: set adminAccessToken instead.
shopify.$primaryLocationId: leave empty to auto-detect the shop's primary location

options.$locale: da | en | de | sv | no — merchant-facing note text, blog defaults, localized structural redirects (src/locales.js)
options.$productStatus: DRAFT (recommended: review then bulk-activate) or ACTIVE
options.$weightUnit: unit configured in WooCommerce: GRAMS | KILOGRAMS | OUNCES | POUNDS
options.$importImagesFrom: source-url = Shopify downloads images from the live WP site during import (site must stay online)
options.$productsBulkThreshold: catalogs larger than this use Shopify bulk operations (JSONL); smaller run synchronous productSet calls
options.$importB2bPricing: When true, create B2B catalogs + price lists and attach group-scoped ProductDiscount rows from raw (_dd_group_discounts). Off by default — public R42 prices unchanged.
options.$importRefunds: When true, call refundCreate for adapter-recorded partial refunds. Default remains label-level fold + REFUND_PARTIAL info warning.
options.$importGiftCards: When true, import transformed/gift-cards.csv via giftCardCreate. No DanDomain GraphQL export (F24 dead).
options.$importTranslations: When true, export secondary SOAP language layers and import transformed/translations.jsonl. Also set source.dandomain.multiLanguage to export layers without importing.
